description.en:
Removes a character from the party. The character is looked up among the party members by parameter ID; nothing happens if they are not in it.
With the pt_lock argument set, the removal routine is called with that flag and nothing else happens. Otherwise the member is removed and, if st_reset is true, their record is also deleted from the saved player data.
The ev_main helpers RemovePartyCmnd and RemoveParty wrap it.
Parameter ID of the character, e.g. "para_cp0010".
true to delete the character's saved record as well (only when ptLock is false).
Flag passed to the removal routine; when true, the record is never deleted.
Always null (also when the character is not in the party or the arguments are missing).

examples.case: Through the ev_main helper (real code, from ie4_ev_main.nut)
